definitionZh: 使可拖动组件可点击或可点击可能很棘手：区分点击和拖动并不总是那么简单。当您将 filterTaps 设置为 true 时，如果总位移小于 3 像素，[tap](/docs/state/#tap) 状态属性在释放时将为 true，而 down 将始终保持 false。
sourceDefinition: Making a draggable component tappable or clickable can be tricky: differenciating a click from a drag is not always trivial. When you set filterTaps to true, the [tap](/docs/state/#tap) state attribute will be true on release if the total displacement is inferior to 3 pixels while down will remain false all along.
